description: Turns lines of text into trimmed WAV files and dur.json. engine "kokoro" is offline (default); "edge" is Microsoft Edge TTS, online; "qwen" is Qwen3-TTS on MLX (Mac with Apple silicon, local, free; voices ryan, aiden, vivian, serena, uncle_fu, dylan, eric, ono_anna, sohee; per-line instruct; numbers spelled out; every take checked for a cut end and by Whisper, bad takes redone). Returns each line's duration. Needs the voice tier (setup.sh deps voice), or for qwen the qwen tier (setup.sh deps qwen; the model, about 3.1 GB, downloads on first use).

asr.description: qwen check and check_voice: what Whisper should hear when it differs.

instruct.description: qwen only: how to say it, e.g. "warm, clear narrator, natural pace".

lang.description: kokoro: en-us, cmn…; qwen: english (default), chinese, japanese, korean, german, french, russian, portuguese, spanish, italian.

say.description: edge and qwen: what is spoken when it differs from text.

out_dir.description: Folder for <id>.wav and dur.json. lines.json is written there too.

name: make_voice
title: Make voice lines (TTS)
